gap: No result ChatGPT got that I could open states that Keychron's own Folio Case for the slim K3 series does not fit the K3 Ultra 8K, K3 HE or K3 Max SE (Keychron: "not compatible due to their larger size"), while Keychron's Low Profile ABS LSA keycap set is listed for both the K3 Max and the K3 Ultra.
standout_why: Compared against mkbguide.com (cited), keeb-finder.com's Air75 V2 / K3 Max / Air75 V3 compare page (cited) and both mechkeyfoundry.com pages (not cited). Between them they already state the main compatibility cells: Lofree boards hot-swap only within Lofree's own low-profile switch family, the Air75 V3 takes Gateron low-profile 3.0 switches and uses NuPhyIO, the K3 Max is hot-swappable only in its RGB hot-swappable version, the K3 Ultra's ZMK is a closed toolchain, and Bluetooth polls at 125 Hz on the NuPhy and K3 Ultra boards. None of them names a maker accessory that fits one K3 generation and not the next, or Keychron's keycap-set fit lists. The RTINGS page (cited) returned only navigation with no article body, and the proxied Wirecutter page (cited), technobezz, keebscout, pcreviewer and rottenwifi were not opened, so 'no result' is limited to the pages named here. The stronger cells for this angle (Lofree's and NuPhy's own switch cross-compatibility statements) could not be read: lofree.co, nuphy.com, pay.nuphy.com and keychron.com product pages returned HTTP 429 on every attempt after the first store searches.
decides: It does not change the pick. It confirms that the two Keychron boards ChatGPT listed are not interchangeable for accessories: by Keychron's figures the K3 Ultra 8K is 320.62 x 126.00 mm against the K3 Max's 306 x 116 mm, and the K3 slim folio case is stated not to fit the Ultra. The K3 Max's hot-swap applies to the RGB hot-swappable version only (Keychron), which matters because the $72.49 read today is a store-search price with the variant not identified. For our row, the Lofree Flow Lite 2 84 stays inside the budget; KitGuru lists Windows, macOS, iOS, iPadOS and Android support and says hot-swap sockets are retained, but which switches fit them is not sourced from Lofree.
